title: Lossless full-preset, timbre-preparation, routing and mixed DSP optimizations

methodology.quantiles: Nearest-rank over pooled samples, never the average of run quantiles
methodology.full_callback_event: AudioWorkletProcessor::Process (outer complete event, including preparation and control handling done inside process)
methodology.message_event: FunctionCall with args.data.functionName SadPetProcessor.port.onmessage on the same worklet thread, reported separately because it is outside process
methodology.author_script: Nested author-script event is retained but not added to the outer callback
methodology.batch_accounting: Browser requested 512 frames (four 128-frame callbacks). Per-quantum overruns alone do not prove an audible glitch. render_plus_intervening_messages is accounted work in a batch, not a scheduler deadline detector.
methodology.playback_stats: Actual AudioContext.playbackStats deltas from /api/diagnostics/memory. State cpu/underruns fields are not used. Diagnostic brackets are slightly wider than trace marks; durations are API counter deltas, not percentages of measured wall time.
methodology.control_latency: Client roundtrip includes preparation, worker context refresh and authoritative binary view delivery. It is not the same as audio-thread blocking time.
limits: Host timing changed substantially during the initial long series in both builds; absolute DSP times cannot be compared with the older baseline report as a code-only effect.
Fresh-process ABBA is a separate series, not pooled with the initial run; host variability remains.
No hard real-time guarantee: first-preset handler and callback maxima still exceed a quantum in some runs; heavy audio-rate sync remains overloaded.
The fresh-process mixed maximum increased from 6.215 to 9.535 ms despite lower pooled p99 and p99.9. PlaybackRing p99.9 did not improve in the initial series.
Timbre preparation uses more callbacks; structural API acknowledgements may wait longer for worker-decoded binary views.

implementation.preset: Reuse live wavetable/mixed voice storage, borrowed JSON deserialization, counting MessagePack sink instead of a discarded encoded buffer, grow-only snapshot buffers, small worklet preset acknowledgement with canonical browser response from stamped binary telemetry.
implementation.preparation: EnginePreparation builds independent banks in separate render quanta; instrument DSP resources are prepared in distinct stages while existing timbres continue playing.
implementation.mixed: Precompute exact dependency reachability for 256 demand masks; rebuild on edge changes, retain dynamic demand and operator-ramp seeds.
implementation.routing: Cache ordered parts, contiguous owner Pad FX spans and bus/master indices; preserve dynamic gains, masks and scalar/control topology changes.
implementation.simd: Share immutable Decimator coefficients and pack the exact stereo filter recurrence under wasm32 simd128; no change to arithmetic ordering, oversampling or read quality.

pcm.scope: Sample-timed before/after PCM, no alignment/gain fitting, factory and mixed full-preset transitions, WT FM/sync, sampler PadFX/bus routing and scene reload

scalar.note: The legacy wavetable-full-edits case differs slightly between scalar and SIMD in both builds; within each variant before/after is bit-identical.

pcm.cross_variant_note: The legacy wavetable-full-edits case already differs between scalar and SIMD in the frozen baseline. Maximum observed absolute cross-variant difference is 7.450580596923828e-7; these changes preserve each variant bit-for-bit, not a new universal scalar/SIMD equivalence claim.
